name: Alpine.js Library support
description: Allows developers to define a js library as plugin or dependent on AlpineJS by making sure the loading order of the JS files are correct.
project_description: Alpine.js Library support bundles Alpine.js 3.15.x and its official plugins (anchor, collapse, focus, intersect, persist, resize) as local Drupal asset libraries and, via a hook_js_alter() implementation, re-sorts the page's JavaScript so that anything flagged as an Alpine plugin loads before Alpine itself starts. A theme or module opts in either by depending on the alpine_js/alpine_js library, by depending on the module and tagging a JS file with attributes: { alpinejs: true }, or by enabling global loading in the settings form at /admin/config/development/alpinejs. The module can deliver the standard build or the CSP-safe build, load in header or footer, restrict or allow admin routes, and toggle individual bundled plugins. All Alpine code is shipped in the module (js/vendor/), not fetched from a CDN.
